hooks.command: eval "$(python3 -c 'import json, shlex, sys; d = json.load(sys.stdin); a = (d.get("toolCall") or {}).get("args", {}) if isinstance(d, dict) else {}; p = a.get("Path") or a.get("path") or a.get("file_path") or ""; w = (d.get("workspacePaths") or [".."])[0]; print(f"FILE_PATH={shlex.quote(p)}; ROOT={shlex.quote(w)}")' 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && [ -f "$FILE_PATH" ]; then case "$FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) (cd "$ROOT" && npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1) || true ;; *.py) (cd "$ROOT" && uvx ruff format "$FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1) || true ;; esac; fi; printf '{}\n'
